@dogdumpling can you test out the APK and see if it solves your issue?

Does this have to be moved here into the player?
The player is already bloated as is and does not need more functionality, that it is not supposed to have.

reply.body: It is needed for appending from the Main player, and I just removed it from PlayQueueActivity to remove duplicated code.

Yeah, I don't like it but nothing that can be done about it here.
I have #8011 in which I will hopefully be able to address it

timeline.body: I think the method should be inlined. The `appendAllToPlaylist` is effectly a single statement

reply.body: If you can inline this, then it can be merged in my view
@XiangRongLin Done, but the Snyk check seems to have found something in `app/build.gradle`. When I click the Details button I can't see what it finds as a vulnerability.
It is unrelated to your changes

timeline.body:

Yes it does - looks good and many thanks for the speedy work!

timeline.message:
Implement appending queue to playlist in main player

This also allows saving a remote playlist locally.

- Add an "Add to playlist" button to the queue menu in the Player.
- Move the appendAllToPlaylist functionality from PlayQueueActivity to
Player.

Fixes: #8004
